headlines.description: — The Celtics spent the days leading up to their playoff matchup with Miami talking about wanting to match the physicality of a team that would be looking for an edge without star Jimmy Butler.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jayson Tatum triple-double, 3s lead Celtics past Butler-less Heat 114-94 in playoff opener

headlines.shortLinkText: Harden and Zubac lead Leonard-less Clippers to 109-97 win over Doncic and Mavs in playoff opener

headlines.description: — Damian Lillard’s sensational start ensured the Milwaukee Bucks would fare just fine without Giannis Antetokounmpo in their playoff opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: Damian Lillard's 35-point 1st half helps Bucks beat Pacers 109-94 without Giannis in playoff opener

events.name: New Orleans Pelicans at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Hours after the NBA announced Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was selected as a finalist for the league’s Most Valuable Player award, Oklahoma City's All-Star guard showed why.
headlines.shortLinkText: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scores 28 points as top-seeded Thunder edge Pelicans 94-92 in Game 1
